critical_code_review_comments: docente_router.py /grupos-comparativa applies academic_notes_match only to historico_notas, but then attaches stats to every group from _my_groups without filtering group metadata. This allows a group whose programa is 'Inglés Fuera de la Malla' to display an average.

academic_filter.NON_ACADEMIC_PROGRAM_REGEX excludes 'fuera de la malla' but not 'INGLES PARA PROFESIONALES'; matching notes with that program produced the displayed 4.2 average under the outside-malla group.

rca_of_the_issue: The grupos-comparativa endpoint builds averages from historico_notas filtered with academic_notes_match, but it does not filter the group list itself by grupo.programa/facultad. The failing group is labeled Inglés Fuera de la Malla; its matching raw notes include excluded fuera-de-malla records and also 'INGLES PARA PROFESIONALES' records not caught by the current regex, resulting in a visible non-academic group average. Repro: login as superadmin, GET /api/dashboards/docente/grupos-comparativa, find codigo_grupo PRECBH2602000_20003.
